expectation: Membrane/fibrous stain of lymphatic endothelium: thin vessels and lacteals in the lamina propria and submucosa, lymphatics in septa running through the muscle layers, and stromal fibroblasts. Uncommon, linear or network-like, and absent from epithelium and blood vessels.
notes: Thin bright lines run through the muscle layers and along the layer boundaries, with dots scattered in the mucosa, the same in both sections. That fits lymphatics and stromal cells, though there is a lot of haze over the muscle and in fields B and C.
observed: A: crisp thin lines cross the muscle layers radially and line the interfaces, with dots in the mucosa; diffuse haze over the muscle. B/C: mostly haze. D: one stellate, fibrous membrane cell. E1: scattered small bright profiles in the lamina propria. E2 (CD21) is flat haze, so it tells us nothing.
why: Distinct linear vessel- or septum-like structures and fibrous stromal cells appear where PDPN belongs, repeated in both sections and well above the haze.
